layer.plainEnglish: The device becomes an action before the graph runs. The base context holds move, look, aim, and interact. Holding the left trigger pushes a second context, so a face button that reloads can instead open a radial slot.
layer.whyGame: Leaving both contexts pushed makes one press reload and equip at once, and reading the key code breaks a rebind.

expansions.title: Base
expansions.detail: Reload lives on the base layer.

expansions.title: Modifier
expansions.detail: The radial lives on the layer that exists only while the trigger is held.

expansions.title: Equip
expansions.detail: The menu sends the equip action with a slot id.

quiz.prompt: The left trigger is held and the face button that usually reloads is pressed. What runs?
choices: The radial slot on the modifier layer
A magazine transfer from the base layer
Both a transfer and a slot change
A raw key comparison inside the reload graph
quiz.why: The trigger pushes the second context.

quiz.prompt: The modifier context is not pushed. What does that face button start?
The radial menu has a slot. Which action should it send?
choices: A magazine transfer, since a face button was used
An immediate burst from the new gun

quiz.prompt: The trigger is released and the modifier context stays pushed. What can one press still do?
choices: Reload and open a slot together
quiz.why: Pop the layer when the trigger comes up.

quiz.prompt: A player rebinds the face button from a key to a pad. What stays the same?
choices: A key-code compare inside the graph

quiz.prompt: The reload graph receives the resolved action and does not compare a face-button key code.
Which actions belong on the base context?
quiz.why: Everyday play is the base layer.

quiz.prompt: When is a pressed device turned into an action?
choices: Inside the graph, from a key code

quiz.prompt: You put the radial binding on the base layer next to reload. What is lost?
choices: A second meaning that appears only while the trigger is held
Ten percent of a limb's max
quiz.why: The second meaning needs the second context.

quiz.prompt: Which step is the modifier layer, not the base reload?
choices: Pushing the extra context while the left trigger is held
Reload firing from the base context
A limb clamped on the server

limb.plainEnglish: A limb is a replicated float with a floor. Damage starts the write, the authority gates it, and a normal hit cannot drop the limb below ten percent of its max. A limb that maxes at 80 floors at 8. The notify plays the limp and does not subtract again.
limb.whyGame: A client subtract snaps when the server number arrives, and a second subtract in the notify bites twice.

expansions.title: The floor
expansions.detail: Ten percent of 80 is 8. Zero is a down, not a bruise.

expansions.title: The sample
expansions.detail: The literal 90 stands in for the clamped result.

expansions.title: The limp
expansions.detail: OnRep plays it. The number is already final.

quiz.prompt: Which event starts a third-person limb write?
The excerpt assigns 90 inside the authority check. What should replace 90?
choices: A constant every bruise must use

quiz.prompt: A bruise would take a limb of max 80 below 8. Where does it land?
choices: Back at eighty, if proxies rejected bruises

quiz.prompt: The limp notify also subtracts. What does one attack become?
quiz.why: The server already wrote the number.

quiz.prompt: A client applies the bruise before the server answers. What jumps back?
choices: The limp, back to the server number
quiz.why: The early number was not authority.

quiz.prompt: A bruise on a limb whose max is 80 stops at 8 rather than emptying it.
Why does this limb have to be one replicated number?
choices: Other players can see the limp
Heat is stored in the same float
quiz.why: The body is on their screen.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the limb write, not the limp?
choices: The clamped assignment inside the authority check
The notify that plays the stumble

quiz.prompt: Tick writes the limb while the player is only running. What falls with no attack?
quiz.why: Damage is the event, not the frame.

quiz.prompt: A hit crosses zero on purpose. What state is that, distinct from a bruise?
choices: A legal bruise at ten percent
quiz.why: The floor holds a bruise. Zero is down.

interest.plainEnglish: Relevant answers whether a client receives the actor. The authority traces twice a second and sets that bool. A third-person camera can stay local even when the pawn is relevant. Visible, on a strategy map, is a different question.
interest.whyGame: A client that sets Relevant pulls pawns the server hid, and treating the camera as interest replicates a local boom.

expansions.title: The timer
expansions.detail: CheckAOI runs every 0.5 seconds inside the authority check.

expansions.title: The camera
expansions.detail: The shoulder camera is local. It is not the relevance bit.

expansions.title: Vision
expansions.detail: Visible is what a team may see. It does not cull the host's simulation.

quiz.prompt: What does Relevant mean for a third-person pawn?
choices: This machine should receive the actor
The shoulder camera is pulled in
The team can see the cell
The limb is below its floor
quiz.why: Interest is delivery, not the camera.

quiz.prompt: CheckAOI assigns Relevant from a trace. What wraps that line?
choices: A half-second loop on the authority
The button that pulls the camera in

quiz.prompt: The pawn is relevant and the shoulder camera stays on the owning machine. What was correctly left local?
choices: Whether the client receives the pawn

quiz.prompt: A client sets Relevant so its animation stays smooth. Who is forced to receive actors the server hid?
choices: No other machine, if a client write could not replicate

quiz.prompt: You use Visible as Relevant on a strategy map. What gets deleted from a spotter's future?
choices: An actor the host still had to simulate

quiz.prompt: The shoulder camera should be replicated as the interest bit.
The trace misses. What should the next assignment do?
choices: Leave the old true bit forever
quiz.why: The bool tracks the hit, including a miss.

quiz.prompt: Why is a third-person pawn stricter about this than a tiny pickup?
choices: The mesh is large and the animation is busy
Limbs require every client to simulate every pawn

quiz.prompt: You save Relevant so a distant pawn stays culled. What is stale after you walk up to it?
choices: The saved bit, which still says the pawn is gone

quiz.prompt: Which line is interest, not the camera?
choices: Relevant assigned from the half-second trace
Aiming set by the shoulder button
A flash that stays on the firing machine

throttle.plainEnglish: A car is a different component. Its axis is throttle, written on the authority. Copying the on-foot sprint of 600 launches the car at a person's pace number. The shoulder camera turns off in the seat. It does not keep aiming, and it does not write throttle.
throttle.whyGame: Wheels are a simulation. Replicating each wheel transform streams bones the client can rebuild from throttle and fuel.

expansions.title: The seat
expansions.detail: Disable the shoulder camera. Do not feed aim into the seat.

expansions.title: Wheels
expansions.detail: Replicate fuel and the order, not every wheel bone.

quiz.prompt: What should the vehicle graph assign?
choices: Throttle from its own axis, on the authority
The lowest a bruise may go
quiz.why: The car reads its own action.

quiz.prompt: Throttle = IA_Throttle runs inside the authority check. What is being copied?
The on-foot speed is copied into throttle. What does the car do?
choices: It launches at a sprint number it was never tuned for
It creeps at a tuned idle

quiz.prompt: The player sits in the car and the shoulder camera keeps tracing. What is still running that should have stopped?
The camera graph writes throttle while the player is seated. What did the boom steal?
choices: How low a normal hit may go

quiz.prompt: The chaos vehicle should read the on-foot speed of 600.
Wheels are a simulation. What should replicate instead of each wheel bone?
choices: Fuel, or the stock the design named, and the order id

quiz.prompt: Driving drains the team's supply stock and the design never said the convoy spends that money. What was coupled?
choices: Fuel and the team's build money
quiz.why: Fuel can be its own number.

quiz.prompt: A client writes throttle so the car feels local. What corrects itself?
choices: The axis, when the authority value arrives
quiz.why: The write sits in the authority check.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the car, not the sprint?
choices: Aiming set by the shoulder button
A limb clamped at ten percent
quiz.why: The axis is not the gait.
